# Job Numbers and Last Week’s Tech/Crypto Rout

Report 190 | Published 2026-06-07 | Evaluated 2026-11-07

[Original member article](https://www.lynalden.com/premium-2026-6-7/) | [Article index](README.md) | [Structured review](../data/reviews/190.json)

Policy restraint, a failed Bitcoin floor and financing risk.

The near-term no-cut call is supported, and the report candidly retracts the Bitcoin bottom view. AWK’s actual entry subsequently performs well. The Strategy reserve critique identifies a real liquidity issue, while attributing the selloff to sentiment remains unproven. Gold-versus-dollar reserve comparisons need tighter denominators.

**Coverage:** Full numbered text and image inventory read. All material theses across macro, digital assets, investment analysis and concluding sections considered. Position listings and incidental descriptive statistics are excluded unless they support a thesis.

### 190-C22

Gold’s market value exceeded foreign official Treasuries in late 2025, but Treasuries are not all dollar reserves, and including U.S. gold makes the comparison asymmetric.
